title: Give the hybrid worker's managed identity access to the Entra Policy Suite database
purpose: Adds the worker machine's managed identity to the Entra Policy Suite database as the contained user eps-hybrid-worker (WITH SID = its client id) in the role eps_worker only (its work packages, its heartbeat, the AD group snapshots; never db_datareader / db_datawriter). You sign in in a browser as the SQL server's Entra admin.
whenToRun: Once per worker, after the worker machine has its managed identity. -Remove when the worker goes.

changes.why: the worker reads its work packages and writes their results and its heartbeat

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription Entra Policy Suite is installed in

parameters.name: WorkerClientId
parameters.help: the client (application) id of the worker machine's managed identity

whatIf: The T-SQL it would run; nothing is run.
